title: Full Detail vs. Exterior Detail: Which Does Your Car Need?
metaDescription: Not sure whether to book a full detail or an exterior-only detail? Ashton's Auto Detailing explains the difference so you get the right service for your car.
keywords: full car detail vs exterior detail
what is included in a car detail
excerpt: Every customer asks the same question at booking time — full detail or exterior only? Here's how to decide.

content.text: Choosing between our Exterior Detail, Interior Detail, and Full Detail packages comes down to one question: where is your vehicle actually showing wear? Here's a breakdown to help you pick the right one.

This covers a professional hand wash, deep wheel and rim cleaning, tire dressing with UV protection, door jamb wipe down, and a paint protection sealant. It's the right call if your interior is in decent shape but your paint has lost its shine or your wheels are caked in brake dust.

A full vacuum of seats, floors, and trunk, UV-protective surface treatment, console and vent cleaning, leather and plastic conditioning, streak-free interior glass, and light stain removal. Ideal for daily drivers, family vehicles, or anyone who eats in the car more than they'd like to admit.

Everything in both packages, plus paint protection sealant across the whole vehicle. This is our most popular package and the best value if it's been more than a few months since your last detail, or if you're prepping the car for sale.
Call 250-709-1371 and describe your vehicle's condition — we'll recommend the right package over the phone, no upsell required. We serve Duncan and the entire Cowichan Valley.
